verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions an API, an OpenAPI spec, or any equivalent machine-readable spec. The llms.txt file and the PDF and report downloads are adjacent features, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
